theory: The definition incorrectly restricts nets to polygons, although the source includes a cylinder net with circles and a curved surface laid flat in image13.png part f. The classification steps also omit cylinders and overstate face inventories as sufficient to establish a valid net; compatible edge lengths and a fold without overlap matter. The source supports recognising prisms from two matching bases joined by rectangles and identifying pyramids from their nets, but does not establish the unrestricted polygon-count rule.
